paragraphs.intro: I am passionate about hard work, literature and technology. I enjoy analyzing things, understanding how they work and, above all, discovering the reasoning behind them. Programming fits this way of thinking particularly well because it is constantly evolving and offers an enormous amount to learn: best practices, design patterns, software architectures, new technologies and different ways to approach and solve problems.
paragraphs.backend: I have contributed to large-scale projects on both the server and client sides. In backend, I have worked on data modeling and processing, architecture and API design, service communication, concurrency, integrations with external systems and testing, paying particular attention to scalability, maintainability and separation of responsibilities.
paragraphs.frontend: In frontend, I have developed complex applications with particular attention to code architecture and organization, reusable component design, state and data-flow management, backend communication, performance, maintainability and user experience.
paragraphs.system: Beyond implementing features, I am interested in understanding the system as a whole, contributing to technical and architectural decisions, analyzing alternative solutions and their trade-offs, identifying design problems and finding approaches that allow software to evolve sustainably as its complexity grows.

current.summary: Software development for industrial environments and distributed systems, contributing to the design, architecture and implementation of frontend and backend solutions, integrations, real-time communications and infrastructure.

details.architecture: Software architecture design and development using Hexagonal Architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), CQRS, TDD, SOLID principles, Clean Code and design patterns, supported by UML for solution design and documentation.
details.backend: Backend development with TypeScript/JavaScript and Node.js, implementing application logic, REST APIs, HTTP/HTTPS services, WebSockets, data processing, persistence and integrations with external systems.
details.apiContracts: RESTful API and communication contract design, including resource modelling, DTOs, validation, error handling and separation between domain, application and infrastructure.
details.eventDriven: Development of event-driven systems and distributed architectures, working with asynchronous communication, producers, consumers, queues, events and message processing through Azure Event Hubs, RabbitMQ and Kafka.
details.websockets: Development of real-time communications using WebSockets, managing subscriptions, reactive change propagation and efficient data updates between backend and frontend.
details.frontend: Frontend development with Angular and Vue.js, working with component-based architectures, services, reactive programming, state management and real-time data flows.
details.three: Extensive experience with Three.js and 3D graphics in web applications, including scene and camera management, rendering, interaction, optimization and tools for importing and visualizing 3D models with support for multiple formats and extensions.
details.industrial: Industrial software development and device integration using protocols such as KNX, Modbus, BACnet, OPC UA and MQTT, working with data reading/writing, device communication and real-time monitoring.
details.nodeRed: Advanced experience with Node-RED, developing integration flows, proofs of concept and custom nodes, particularly for industrial communications, data processing and system integration.
details.mqtt: Design and validation of MQTT communications using EMQX, including client, connection, topic and session management and monitoring, as well as broker load and behaviour testing.
details.security: Implementation of secure communications using TLS/mTLS, working with certificates, certificate authorities, mutual client-server authentication and encrypted communications.
details.testing: Software test design and execution, applying TDD and developing unit, integration and end-to-end tests to validate components, services and complete application flows.
details.cicd: CI/CD management with Azure DevOps, configuring and maintaining application build, test and deployment pipelines, as well as delivery processes in cloud environments.
details.azure: Experience with Azure and cloud services, particularly in application integration, messaging, event processing and solution deployment.
details.docker: Application development and containerization with Docker, working with services, environment configuration and reproducible deployment of software components.
details.cpp: Software development with C++, working directly with operating-system APIs and libraries, as well as integrating native components and low-level resources.
details.languages: Application and tool development with C#, alongside experience with Python, TypeScript, JavaScript and C++ in different application contexts.
details.integration: Frontend-backend integration and communication between heterogeneous systems, combining APIs, WebSockets, messaging systems, industrial protocols and cloud services.
details.decisions: Technical analysis and decision-making, evaluating architectural alternatives, maintainability, performance, scalability, security, coupling and software evolution.
details.coordination: Technical coordination and development planning, contributing to solution definition, task breakdown, technical tracking and collaboration with multidisciplinary teams.
details.mongodb: Experience with MongoDB, working with document modelling, queries, aggregations, indexes, optimization, persistence of large data volumes and retention policies.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: A selection of work representing my journey across different areas of software engineering.

realTimeIndustrialPlatform.title: Industrial monitor
realTimeIndustrialPlatform.description: A dynamic industrial monitoring application that updates PLC tags in real time and renders configurable screens from JSON definitions.
realTimeIndustrialPlatform.challenge: Connect PLC readings with a responsive monitoring interface while keeping the backend maintainable, the communication real-time and the screens configurable without hardcoding each view.
realTimeIndustrialPlatform.contribution: I contributed across the stack: building backend APIs and real-time communication, integrating event and persistence services, and developing Angular services, components and an SVG renderer driven by JSON configuration.

responsibilities.renderer: Dynamic SVG renderer from JSON configuration

realTimeIndustrialPlatform.result: A configurable industrial monitoring application capable of receiving PLC data, processing it through a structured backend and updating dynamic SVG screens in real time.

interactive3dEngineeringTool.title: KNX digital twin
interactive3dEngineeringTool.description: A digital twin of a KNX installation, combining a Node.js backend, an Angular frontend and a local Electron desktop application.
interactive3dEngineeringTool.challenge: Build a maintainable digital twin that connects an industrial installation with a reactive interface and a local desktop runtime while keeping the backend architecture structured and extensible.
interactive3dEngineeringTool.contribution: I contributed to the backend and frontend and developed the Electron layer: from use cases, endpoints and adapters to Angular signals, component structure, IPC event typing and executable delivery pipelines.
interactive3dEngineeringTool.result: A local digital twin application capable of representing a KNX installation through a structured Node.js backend, a reactive Angular interface and an Electron runtime.

outcomes.backend: Structured backend with reusable use cases and adapters
outcomes.frontend: Reactive Angular interface with reusable components
outcomes.desktop: Typed IPC and automated EXE generation

roboticChess.title: UR Chess
roboticChess.description: A system connecting a chess game to a robotic arm so that every move can be physically executed.
roboticChess.challenge: Coordinate chess logic, the interface and safe robot movement by translating every play into physical positions on a real board.
roboticChess.contribution: I implemented the game logic and interface, the communication protocol, and the transformation of logical moves into sequences executable by the robotic arm.
roboticChess.result: A functional prototype capable of validating moves and transferring them into the physical world by integrating software, communications and robotic automation.

unity2dGame.title: RPG in Unity
unity2dGame.description: A complete 2D video game developed in Unity, covering gameplay, visual assets, animation and scene construction.
unity2dGame.challenge: Turn a game concept into a coherent playable experience by coordinating movement, sprites, animations, backgrounds and levels.
unity2dGame.contribution: I worked across the complete development process, from building the visual resources to implementing movement, animations, backgrounds, scenarios and gameplay logic.
unity2dGame.result: A playable 2D experience that combines custom visual resources with interactive mechanics and structured Unity scenes.

unity3dShooter.title: 3D shooter in Unity
unity3dShooter.description: A 3D shooter developed in Unity, combining player movement, combat mechanics, animations and complete game environments.
unity3dShooter.challenge: Build a coherent 3D shooter by bringing together camera control, player movement, combat, physics and scene design.
unity3dShooter.contribution: I developed the game systems and environments, working on the same end-to-end areas as the 2D project: movement, animations, scenarios, backgrounds and gameplay.
unity3dShooter.result: A functional 3D shooter prototype demonstrating the integration of gameplay systems, 3D environments and interactive scenes in Unity.

yayaRecipes.title: YAYA recipe app
yayaRecipes.description: A recipe application built with a React Native frontend and a Java backend, developed as a full-stack academic project.
yayaRecipes.challenge: Connect a mobile recipe experience with a backend capable of exposing, processing and persisting application data.
yayaRecipes.contribution: I contributed across the stack by implementing parts of the frontend styling, connecting the application to backend services, creating endpoints and defining persistence through annotated classes.
yayaRecipes.result: A connected recipe application that combines a mobile client with Java services and a mapped persistence layer.
